context: Kenji helps Yuki with a messaging tool.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: tech help; vocabulary (返信/音声/ツール/教材/ダウン) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: このツール、返信が遅いんです。
lines.en: This tool is slow to reply.
lines.style: puzzled office woman voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: サーバーが、ダウンしているようですね。
lines.en: The server seems to be down.
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 音声のメッセージも、送れますか?
lines.en: Can I send voice messages too?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、音声も、このツールで送れます。
lines.en: Yes, you can send voice with this tool too.
lines.style: clear office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 研修の教材も、ここに置けますか?
lines.en: Can I put the training materials here too?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 教材を、ツールで共有しましょう。
lines.en: Let's share the materials via the tool.
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm patient guiding throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 復旧したら、返信が来ました!
lines.en: Once it recovered, the reply came!
lines.style: relieved office woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ダウンが直れば、音声もスムーズですよ。
lines.en: Once the downtime's fixed, voice is smooth too.
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
